//: Why the experimental option below: @artblocks/abx-storage declares @artblocks/abx-storage-arweave
as an OPTIONAL PEER dependency, and Changesets majors any package that declares a peer dependency
on something being bumped. That rule turned a minor release of the new adapter into
@artblocks/abx-storage@1.0.0-alpha.31 -- a jump to a 1.0 line that does not exist, while every
sibling stayed 0.1.0-alpha.x, and it would have recurred on EVERY future adapter bump. Verified by
running `pnpm ci:version` with and without the peer block (1.0.0-alpha.31 vs 0.1.0-alpha.31).
The peer range is deliberately a permissive `>=0.1.0-alpha.0` rather than `workspace:*`, because
pnpm rewrites the workspace protocol to an EXACT version at publish time -- which would force a
consumer to match the adapter version exactly, and break on every storage patch release. A
permissive range stays satisfied, which is what makes the opt-out below apply.
The key is namespaced ___experimentalUnsafeOptions_WILL_CHANGE_IN_PATCH by Changesets: if a future
Changesets upgrade renames it, `pnpm ci:version` will start producing a major for abx-storage
again. Dry-run `pnpm ci:version` and check the versions before any release that bumps the adapter.
